name: Sunshine Motor Repairs & Tyres
tagline: Honest, reliable car servicing and tyres in Sunshine North
description: Sunshine Motor Repairs & Tyres is a trusted local auto workshop based in Sunshine North, Melbourne. The team handles all mechanical and auto-electrical repairs, log book servicing on all makes and models with company stamp, roadworthy certificates, fleet servicing, and supplies and fits a wide range of tyres and rims. Customers value the workshop for transparent pricing, clear communication, fast turnaround, and doing the job right the first time.
